activity.notes: Levski built the clandestine Internal Revolutionary Organisation inside Ottoman-ruled Bulgarian lands from 1869 until his arrest in 1872. ATLAS associates him with the Bulgarian revolutionary organization rather than misclassifying him as an Ottoman political representative or a ruler of a sovereign Bulgaria.

sources.title: Short chronicle of Levski's life — Vasil Levski National Museum, Karlovo
sources.citation_text: The Vasil Levski National Museum documents his organizing tours, revolutionary committee network, arrest in 1872 and execution in 1873.
